# Published v0.4.0 compatibility fixture

`format1.db` was produced by the published Go module v0.4.0 (tag commit
`af25930d0e6f3bf3e69b1ee7b4c71a42ac93871d`), using its own pinned dependencies,
then closed/checkpointed. It is not generated by the code under test.
`manifest.json` records its checksum and storage format; `records.json` records
the normalized definitions and read results from that release.

It covers all 20 native data types, exact JSON numbers/decimals, SQL NULL versus
JSON null, optional dense/float16/binary/sparse vectors, native string/UUID/int64
keys, generated-key state, and required-vector registrations with omitted defaults.
The compatibility test copies the file before opening/mutating it.

Keep released fixtures immutable. Add a new directory for a future format/release.
To reproduce the generator, use a fresh temporary module/directory, copy
`generate.go` to `main.go` and remove its build constraint, then run:

```sh
go mod init fixture.example/generate
go mod edit -go=1.25.0 -require=github.com/gabisonia/go-vectorstore@v0.4.0
go mod tidy
go run . -out /path/to/new-fixture-directory
```

The generator refuses to overwrite an existing database. Do not regenerate this
fixture using a replace directive or the current repository module. SQLite binary
layout may vary with toolchain/driver versions; review semantic output and record
provenance when intentionally creating another fixture.
